title: Pure Yubel
summary: The Yubel monsters and the 2024 cards that mention them, with generic staples. Neos Wiseman and Elemental HERO Neos Kluger need Elemental HERO Neos and are left out. Every Yubel has 0 ATK, can't be destroyed by battle, and turns battles back on the attacker. The deck destroys its own Yubel on purpose to climb from Yubel to Terror Incarnate to The Ultimate Nightmare. Nightmare Pain destroys a DARK monster to search a Yubel card, Nightmare Throne fetches the next Yubel and summons it whenever one leaves the field, and Samsara D Lotus tributes itself to summon a Yubel from the Deck. On the opponent's turn, Samsara D Lotus and Phantom of Yubel rewrite their monster effects into destroying your own Yubel, which only feeds the climb. Yubel - The Loving Defender Forever is the Fusion boss that can't be destroyed. Phantom of Yubel is Limited.
main: Spirit of Yubel
Summons itself on an attack; adds or sets a Yubel Spell/Trap; brings out Yubel when destroyed.
Yubel
Can't be destroyed by battle; burns attackers; destroyed, becomes Terror Incarnate.
Samsara D Lotus
Tributes itself to summon a Yubel from the Deck; rewrites their monster effect on their turn.
Gruesome Grave Squirmer
Summons itself next to a Fiend and destroys your Yubel to climb; revives a 0/0 Fiend.
Yubel - Terror Incarnate
Destroys every other monster in your End Phase; becomes The Ultimate Nightmare.
Yubel - The Ultimate Nightmare
The top of the climb: burns and destroys attackers.
Geistgrinder Golem
Goes to their field to put a Yubel on yours from the hand.
Nightmare Pain
Destroys a DARK monster to search a Yubel card; redirects battle damage.
Nightmare Throne
Searches a 0/0 Fiend; fetches and summons the next Yubel when one leaves.
Mature Chronicle
Counts Yubel summons to revive, recover, banish or destroy.
Super Polymerization
Generic Quick-Play Fusion that Mature Chronicle fetches for The Loving Defender.
Eternal Favorite
Revives a Yubel unanswerably, or Fusion Summons with a Yubel from either field.
